description:
List the skills (step-by-step procedures) this caller may load.

Three kinds of row, told apart by `tier`:

* `shared` -- promoted into the shared skill library. Carries `name`, `description`, `version`, `content_sha256` and its provenance (`source_agent`, `promoted_by`, `promoted_at`). `get_skill` returns its body.
* `advertised` -- a skill an agent keeps locally and lists in its manifest (only with `include_local`, the default). One row per `content_sha256`, naming every agent that has it in `advertised_by`, with `origin` when known and `shared` (`matches` / `diverged`) when a shared skill has the same bytes or name. Not loadable until promoted.
* `proposed` -- a skill proposed for the shared library (`propose_skill`) and awaiting a person's approval (only with `include_local`; a trusted caller sees every pending proposal, any other caller its own).

`query` filters by a case-insensitive substring of the name or description. Rows follow the caller's access ceiling; advertised rows come only from namespaces the caller may read.
name: list_skills
title: List skills
